$description: Sunset Soul design tokens. The single source of truth for color, type, spacing, radius and size. Dark is the brand's default theme; light follows the phone's setting.

brand-twilight-navy.$description: The brand color. App icon tile, dark-mode page, text color in light mode.

brand-blue-hour.$description: Second brand blue. The earth in the app icon and raised surfaces in dark mode.

brand-cream.$description: Warm cream. Light-mode page and text on navy.

brand-apricot.$description: The sun in the logo and every score. The one warm accent.

brand-peach-blush.$description: The beams in the logo on dark grounds and the selected reaction.

brand-ocean-blue.$description: The action blue in its light-mode strength.

surface-page.$description: Screen background behind every photo and story.

surface-raised.$description: Unselected reaction chips, text fields, sheets and cards on surface-page.

surface-sunken.$description: Areas set back from the page: the area behind sheets, empty states, the Share Page margins.

border-subtle.$description: Borders of reaction chips, text fields and secondary buttons. 3:1 or better on surface-page and surface-raised, so controls are easy to find. Cards use no border.

divider.$description: Hairlines between sections and above the tab bar.

ink.$description: Titles, labels and primary text on surface-page and surface-raised. 11:1 or better in both themes.

ink-story.$description: Story text, set in the story style, on surface-page.

ink-muted.$description: Dates, counts, the Wow reason line and other quiet text on surface-page and surface-raised. 5.6:1 or better.

ink-accent.$description: Warm accent text, such as Soul in the wordmark. Large text only (24px and up) in light mode.

action.$description: The one primary button per screen (Save, Send, Share) and the capture button. Lifted in dark mode so it shows on navy. The button is identified by its label; the fill is 2.4:1 against navy in dark mode.

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard and accessibility focus outline, 3px, on every surface.

reaction-selected.$description: Fill of a reaction chip the person has tapped (Wow, Wish I was there, Love this!, Sending hugs). A fill only: never a text or icon color in light mode, where it reads at about 1.4:1 on cream.

reaction-selected-border.$description: 1px border on reaction-selected so the chip reads as pressed.

score.$description: Score badge fill, shown only in the Score details row on Entry Detail. Never on photos. A fill only: in light mode a score is always a badge with on-score numbers, never apricot text.

photo-scrim.$description: Behind white text laid over a photo (home-screen previews, share cards only).

map-water.$description: Live Map oceans and lakes. Night water in dark mode, soft sky blue in light mode.

map-pin-ring.$description: 3px ring around each photo pin on the Live Map.

map-pin-outline.$description: 1.5px outline outside map-pin-ring, so pins stand out on land and water alike.

title-2.$description: Entry titles on Entry Detail and the Share Page.

title-3.$description: Featured card titles in the Journal.

story.$description: Every story and friend note. Set in ink-story.

body-strong.$description: Grid tile titles and emphasis inside body.

label.$description: Buttons, reaction chips and the score number.

caption.$description: Dates, counts and the Wow reason line. The smallest reading size in the app.

overline.$description: Short uppercase section labels only, never sentences.

space-1.$description: Gap between a number and its label.

space-2.$description: Gap between reaction chips and between a photo and its title.

space-4.$description: Screen side margins and card padding.

space-8.$description: Top of screen to the title.

space-10.$description: Breathing room above and below empty states.

radius-md.$description: Photos, text fields and primary buttons.

radius-pill.$description: Reaction chips and the round capture button.

tap-min.$description: Smallest tappable area for anything. Larger than the platform minimum, for our 50 to 65 audience.

capture-button.$description: The round capture button in the tab bar.

icon.$description: Line icons in buttons and the tab bar.

tab-bar-height.$description: Bottom tab bar, not counting the phone's safe area.
